mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDate, SUM(o.total_amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(o.id) AS totalNum FROM order_info o WHERE DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=#{createDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDate, SUM(o.total_amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(o.id) AS totalNum FROM order_info o WHERE DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate} AND DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY orderDate
